run_bigvgan_training: run BigVGAN audio waveform generation model training with configurable discriminators and loss functions
run_bigvgan_evaluation: run BigVGAN evaluation from checkpoint and exit without training
run_bigvgan_distributed_training: run BigVGAN distributed multi-GPU training with DistributedDataParallel and checkpoint resumption
run_bigvgan_fine_tuning: run BigVGAN fine-tuning on a custom dataset with unseen validation speakers for evaluation
run_bigvgan_resume_training: run BigVGAN training resuming from latest checkpoint with generator and discriminator optimizer states
